items.summary: Key TakeawaysDavid Einhorn’s Greenlight Capital more than doubled its Comcast stake, added 55% to Viatris and opened a new position in SL Green Realty in the third quarter, its latest 13F shows. items.title: A 72-Year-Old With $1,000,000 in Comcast, Noble and First Interstate BancSystem Collects $4,323 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA $1,000,000 portfolio split evenly across Comcast, Noble and First Interstate BancSystem pays about $51,900 a year in dividends at today’s prices. Comcast’s dividend took 24% of its free cash flow over the last 12 months, and First Interstate’s took 64% of its normalized earnings in fiscal 2025.

items.title: Comcast (CMCSA) Stock May Be A Bargain After Gaming Network News
items.summary: Comcast shares have climbed in the short term but are still well below where they were five years ago, which puts fresh focus on whether the current price really lines up with what the business earns. With the spotlight back on its connectivity and media assets, the core issue for you is how much of Comcast's earnings story is already baked into the US$25.73 share price. Over the past 5 years the stock has fallen 36.5%. The valuation question now turns on whether the market has simply reset...
